console.security.settings.backup-help: Export an existing local device vault as a user-held .kvkb file. Keep the file and recovery secret separately. No keys are uploaded. Restore only into an empty local device slot for the same account and workspace; this archive does not establish server freshness. Archive version 1 uses backup epoch 1.
console.security.settings.error: The operation was refused. Check the peer details, recovery method and file, then start a new local session if needed.
console.security.settings.passphrase-hel: Use at least 12 characters and a long, unique phrase. Derivation uses 600,000 iterations; forgotten phrases cannot be reset.
console.security.settings.peer-codes: Enter the other device’s eight groups, separated by spaces
console.security.settings.peer-endorseme: Other device’s endorsement of this session (JSON)
console.security.settings.recovery-help: Save all 17 groups, including the last checksum group. This key is shown only in this flow and is cleared when dismissed or when the session ends.
console.security.settings.restored: Archive restored locally. Current server authority and device validation are still required before use.
console.security.settings.saved: I saved the recovery key separately
console.security.settings.status: Status: local verification and user-held encrypted archives. Server key-backup storage and durable account cross-signing are not available.
console.security.settings.title: Security and sign-in
console.security.settings.vault-absent: No local device vault is available to export. You can import an archive; no replacement device is generated.
console.security.settings.vault-present: An existing local device vault can be exported. Import is disabled to protect it.
console.security.settings.verification-h: This session has a temporary verification key, not an admitted messaging identity. Exchange the public descriptors and the same session nonce over an independent trusted channel. Compare all eight groups of four digits. The seven-word shortcut provides a shorter, weaker comparison.
console.security.settings.verified: Peer signature checked for this session. This does not publish account trust.
